metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code mods: our own and third-party ones we use, each credited to its author.

plugins.name: arcade-dash
plugins.description: 8-bit arcade dashboard: score band, compact tool rows, arcade spinner and branch status

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Live agent dashboard by Stephen Casella (vendored, MIT). Upstream: https://github.com/scasella/claude-flightdeck

plugins.name: fueldeck
plugins.description: Flightdeck plus a fuel panel: session tokens by loop and model, cache hits, and what each plugin, skill and MCP server costs in context

plugins.name: dailyred-dash
plugins.description: Daily Red in a pane: battle RED with today's team on the real FireRed engine (builds the game locally; see its README)

plugins.name: presentation-deck
plugins.description: Build themed 16:9 PowerPoint decks from a JSON outline: cards, steps, flows, stats, timelines, framed screenshots and speaker notes

plugins.name: agent-link
plugins.description: Send Markdown tasks to a partner's Claude Code over your LAN (shared-token HTTP); their Claude auto-reviews with no tools, or holds it in an inbox for a collab session
